Shaw Pong Liu's A Golden Seam uses violin, erhu, voice, original composition, improvisation, story and audience participation to explore birth, loss and remade identity. Tabla artist Sandeep Das then curates Raga, Rhythm, and Rasa, an Indian classical chamber program organized around navarasa, raga, complex rhythm and spontaneous improvisation. events.factual_description: National Sawdust presents Silkroad Up-Close on April 28, 2027 at 7:30 PM, with doors at 6:30 PM. Shane Shanahan's Cycles Beyond Time brings percussion, oud and guitar, violin, South Indian voice and bass into original compositions drawing on Indian, Middle Eastern, jazz, rock and minimalist traditions. Edward Perez then leads a program with pianist Alex Brown, percussionist Keita Ogawa and vocalist Mahya Hamedi that joins jazz improvisation to Latin and Persian-rooted vocabularies and culminates in a world premiere written for the occasion.
